title: Beyond Epic Fight WEAPON compat
description: Epic Fight WEAPON compatiblity for a wide range of mods
body:
A datapack that changes the movesets of weapons so they're compatible with epic fight.

Must have Requirements that were tested to definitely work:

[Epic Fight 20.14.17](https://modrinth.com/mod/epic-fight), [Weapons of Miracles 2.0.164](https://modrinth.com/mod/weapons-of-miracles), [Epic Fight: Resurrection 20.12.2](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/epicfight-resurrection), [Epic Fight: Nightfall 3.3.6](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/epicfight-nightfall)

More dependencies are not planned.
(Unless of course i find a really cool mod that allows me to use it's movesets and can incorporate it)

![Over 50 mods supported](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bec5ca757348d4bd391cfcca0673d9b36431c0bc_0.webp)

Things to note: 

- Movesets were added using epic fight's built in datapack editor
- Primarily meant for the Beyond Ascension modpack on curseforge but uploaded here on a request so weapons might be added according to the needs of the modpack but do not hesitate to ask if you'd like to see something added (On Curseforge under the same name or on discord)

How to install:

Install Global Packs (or something that does a similar thing like PAXI) and put it in resourcepack folder (For PAXI there is a folder in the configs) or put it into the datapacks folder of every world you create
